messages:
sarah: Postmortem follow-up: recurring multi-region LB routing + TLS handshake spikes. From the incident earlier today — we saw cross-region retries and ~5% TLS failures during bursts. Need owners and timelines for remediations. TL;DR: routing sync bug, cert chain rotation, alert tuning, and runbook gaps. @kevin @devon can you pick owners?

kevin: I'll take routing sync. Root cause seems like stale route table entries during ASG scale events. Plan: add a reconciliation loop + metrics. ETA: 2w, patch branch by EOD Monday. I'll post PR link when ready. :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll own alerting and recurring pattern analysis. Will run a 90-day query for cross-region retry spikes and produce a heatmap. ETA: 4 business days. Also will add a dashboard panel and pager thresholds.

devon: I'll handle cert chain rotation issues and the TLS handshake flakiness. Suspect some LB -> backend SNI mismatch on fallback hosts. I'll coordinate with infra to force a rotation on non-prod first. ETA: 3 days, rollback plan included.

kevin: Quick note — here's a minimal repro command to dump route discrepancy across regions:
```
# compare LB routes
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:LB,Values=redwood-lb --region us-east-1 | jq '.RouteTables[] | {id: .RouteTableId, routes: .Routes}' > r1.json
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --region us-west-2 | jq '.RouteTables[] | {id: .RouteTableId, routes: .Routes}' > r2.json
diff -u r1.json r2.json
```

maria: Added to tracker: recurring postmortem item: monthly LB routing audit. Will add to calendar and assign to oncall rotation. @sarah can you confirm calendar invite cadence?

sarah: Yep, monthly cadence is fine. Add to infra review every 1st Tue. Also add a KPI: <1% cross-region retries per week.

elena: small ops-bot note: deploy-bot posted rollback for lb-service at 1755080200 during incident. Logged to incident doc: /incidents/17550800-lb-retry-incident

devon: After initial rotation on staging, TLS error rate dropped from 5.2% -> 0.3%. Will schedule prod rotation Thu night with 2-hour maintenance window. ETA update: prod rotation Thu 23:00 UTC.

kevin: PR: https://github.com/redwood/recon/commit/abc123 — adds reconciliation loop + metric lb.route.stale_count. Will instrument, then enable canary in us-west-2.

maria: Uploaded heatmap and first-pass analysis to the incident doc. Findings: spike correlates with cross-region failover events and autoscaling churn. Next steps: tune scale-down protection and increase route reconcile frequency.

sarah: Action items summary (copied for clarity):
- kevin: route reconcile PR + canary -> 2w
- devon: cert rotation prod -> Thu 23:00 UTC
- maria: analysis + dashboard + monthly audit -> 4d
- ops: add LB routing audit to infra review
Please update the tracker checklist as you complete items. Check-ins next Tue 15:00 UTC. :eyes:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up sync Tue 15:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).
